description: This bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy (instilled preferences) of two large language models — GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini — under three experimental conditions: Control, Before Introspection Training, and After Introspection Training. The vertical axis represents “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)” on a scale from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick marks at 0.25 intervals. The horizontal axis categorizes the models into two groups: GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini. For each model, three bars are shown: a light gray bar for “Control,” a light blue bar for “Before Introspection Training,” and a dark purple bar for “After Introspection Training.” Error bars indicate variability or confidence intervals for each measurement. In GPT-4o, the Control condition shows low accuracy (~0.15), Before Training is higher (~0.55), and After Training reaches ~0.75. In GPT-4o-mini, the Control condition is near zero (slightly negative, ~-0.05), Before Training is ~0.50, and After Training is ~0.75. The chart visually demonstrates that introspection training significantly improves self-report accuracy in both models compared to baseline or control conditions, with GPT-4o-mini showing a slightly lower pre-training accuracy but comparable post-training performance to GPT-4o. The legend in the upper right corner clearly maps colors to conditions, and all bars are grouped by model for direct comparison.
